'''Survey Team 63529''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] survey team assigned to the [[Cartography and Surveying]] division. Under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Trask (commander)|Trask]], the team carried out an eight-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] survey of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]]. During the deployment, the team was overly tense, causing Trask to have to intervene on more than one occasion to prevent disputes from flaring into violence.
